My Mum can be quite overbearing and likes to be involved in my business since I’ve been home again, for example, when I went to visit my father a few hours away over the Christmas’s period she was texting me daily saying how much she misses and loves me. I reciprocate with a ‘love you too ma’ but the constant pandering was a little much for me. This issue arose again recently. Ma and her husband went on a mini break for five days. Honestly I don’t think I was being an arsehole, just that my mum needs to cut the apron strings a little. But I await my judgement!

It’s like your outfit acts as a mental "switch" that helps you step into a confident mindset, especially in professional or high-stakes situations.
